verdict.rationale: Gecko generates AI insights from the user's own code inside the product: findings with severity, confidence scores, call chains and suggested patches, an AI-written repository wiki covering architecture and security model, and AI security review summaries on PRs. A community hands-on report of false positives scored at 100% confidence calls the accuracy of these insights into question, but it does not show the capability is absent. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the insights are accurate (community reports false positives), and evidence of in-product conversational or ad-hoc querying of the data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Repository wiki: An AI-written map of your app: architecture, routing, and security model.
Each finding includes a severity (CVSS 4.0), a confidence score, the full source-to-sink call chain, a proof of concept, and a suggested patch.
PR reviews & fixes: On pull requests, a security review summary and one-click fixes.
